expectations.text: models/client.go uses both `db:` and `json:` struct tags, with a nullable field as a pointer type (e.g. UpdatedAt *time.Time)
expectations.evidence: internal/models/client.go:6-10 — every field carries both tags, e.g. `ID uint32 `db:"id" json:"id"`` and line 10: `UpdatedAt *time.Time `db:"updated_at" json:"updated_at,omitempty"`` (nullable as pointer type).

expectations.text: repository/client.go defines a Client interface with Create/Get/Update/Delete accepting context.Context as first param, plus a private implementation struct and a public constructor returning the interface
expectations.evidence: internal/repository/client.go:16-21 — `type Client interface` with Create/Get/Update/Delete, each taking `ctx context.Context` first; lines 24-26 private `type client struct { db *sqlx.DB }`; lines 29-33 `func NewClientRepository(db *sqlx.DB) Client` returning the interface.

expectations.text: repository maps sql.ErrNoRows to a typed sentinel error (e.g. ErrClientNotFound)
expectations.evidence: internal/repository/client.go:13 — `var ErrClientNotFound = errors.New("client not found")`; lines 56-58 in Get: `if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) { return nil, ErrClientNotFound }`.

expectations.text: usecase/client.go defines a ClientUsecase interface, a private implementation struct, and a NewClientUsecase constructor; Create wraps repo errors with fmt.Errorf and %w
expectations.evidence: internal/usecase/client.go:23-28 — `type ClientUsecase interface` (Create/Get/Update/Delete); lines 31-33 private `type clientUsecase struct { repo repository.Client }`; lines 36-40 `func NewClientUsecase(repo repository.Client) ClientUsecase`; line 46 Create: `return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create client: %w", err)`.

expectations.text: Handler files are plain functions (not methods on a struct) and call the usecase via app.A.Usecase.Client — never app.A.Service or app.A.Repository directly
expectations.evidence: All four handlers are plain package-level functions (`func CreateClient(ctx echo.Context) error` etc.). Grep of internal/http shows all usecase call sites go through app.A.Usecase.Client: create_client.go:31, get_client.go:22, update_client.go:33, delete_client.go:22; zero occurrences of app.A.Service or app.A.Repository in handlers.

expectations.text: Logging uses zap (log.Logger.Error / log.Logger.Info), not fmt.Println or stdlib log
expectations.evidence: All four handlers log via `log.Logger.Error("...", zap.Error(err))` with `"go.uber.org/zap"` imported (e.g. create_client.go:23,33; get_client.go:24). Grep found no fmt.Println, no stdlib `log` import, and no log.Print calls in the run. (internal/log/log.go itself is not shipped; the run assumes the existing scaffold.)
